collectProtocolFees(uint256).details: Fees accumulate in this contract as ERC-20.      Multisig can convert to USDC via DEX or hold as L1T/L3T.

params.amount: ERC-20 amount to withdraw (18 dec). Pass 0 to withdraw all.

params._harvestRateBps: Initial harvest rate in basis points (e.g. 1000 = 10%)
params._harvestToken: ERC-20 to distribute on harvest (e.g. L1T)

fundReserve(uint256).details: Multisig must approve this contract on the ERC-20 before calling

harvestERC20(uint256).details: INV-2: WhaleVault harvest token validated and consumed here.         INV-5: Only original lock owner can harvest.         Cooldown enforced between harvests (default 30 days).         Gross harvest amount (18-dec):           gross = faceValueUSD × harvestRateBps / PRECISION × 1e12         Protocol fee deducted from gross:           fee       = gross × protocolFeeBps / PRECISION           netToHolder = gross - fee         Fee accumulates in contract.         Multisig withdraws via collectProtocolFees().

returns.netToHolder: ERC-20 amount sent to owner after fee (18 dec)

lockNFTs(uint256[]).details: Caller must call ERC-721.setApprovalForAll(vault, true) first.         INV-1: NFTs transferred into custody here.         INV-2: WhaleVault harvest token required and validated.         Conflicts with MintingRightsVault: token IDs locked as minting         rights cannot be locked here simultaneously.

params.tokenIds: EWB token IDs to lock (must be owned by msg.sender)

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params._rateBps: New rate in basis points (max HARVEST_RATE_MAX_BPS = 5000)

setHarvestToken(address).details: Only callable by multisig. Allows switching between L1T / L3T etc.

setProtocolFee(uint256).details: Capped at PROTOCOL_FEE_MAX_BPS (25%).      Fee is deducted from each harvest before sending to holder.

unlockNFTs(uint256).details: INV-4: Cannot unlock while pending harvest obligation exists.         INV-5: Only original lock owner can unlock.         After unlock, lock marked inactive and tokenIds cleared from registry.

params.lockId: Lock to close and withdraw NFTs from

DEFAULT_PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS().notice: Default protocol fee: 2% of each harvest emission

HARVEST_RATE_MAX_BPS().notice: Safety cap — harvest rate cannot exceed 50%

PROTOCOL_FEE_MAX_BPS().notice: Safety cap — protocol fee cannot exceed 25% of harvest

accumulatedFees().notice: Accumulated protocol fees not yet withdrawn (18 dec ERC-20 units)

coldWallet().notice: Cold hardware wallet — emergency pause only

collectProtocolFees(uint256).notice: Withdraw accumulated protocol fees to multisig

fundReserve(uint256).notice: Fund this vault with ERC-20 reserve for harvest payouts

getLock(uint256).notice: Full lock details including accrued harvest availability

getOwnerLocks(address).notice: All lock IDs belonging to an address

harvestCooldown().notice: Seconds between permitted harvests per lock

harvestERC20(uint256).notice: Harvest ERC-20 tokens against the face value of locked NFTs

harvestRateBps().notice: Basis points of faceValueUSD paid out per harvest cycle

harvestTokenAddress().notice: ERC-20 token distributed on harvest (e.g. L1T or L3T)

lockNFTs(uint256[]).notice: Lock EWB NFTs into this vault to begin earning ERC-20 harvest

protocolFeeBps().notice: Protocol fee in basis points taken from each harvest (e.g. 200 = 2%)

setHarvestToken(address).notice: Update the ERC-20 harvest token address

totalFeesCollected().notice: Total protocol fees collected all time (18 dec ERC-20 units)

withdrawReserve(uint256).notice: Withdraw unused reserve back to multisig
